text:
Lin: hey folks, first-day onboarding hiccup — trying to finish MDM enrollment and FileVault on my M2 MBP but it keeps failing at the escrow step. created a YubiKey-backed personal recovery key and now Kandji shows "escrow failed". anyone seen this?
jamie-it: welcome Lin! quick q — did you enable FileVault before the Kandji MDM profile installed, or after?
Lin: enabled FileVault during macOS setup, then ran the Kandji enrollment link. I followed the onboarding doc but the final step says "waiting for escrow" forever.
kate-kandji: Kandji here — if FileVault was turned on with a personal recovery key (YubiKey OTP flow), the device sometimes doesn't generate the escrowed institutional key. can you paste output of `sudo fdesetup status`?
Lin: sure, here's the snippet I ran:```bash
$ sudo fdesetup status
FileVault is On.
Users: Lin (Enabled)
Escrow: No institutional recovery key found
```
Lin: also when I try to add a recovery key via System Settings -> FileVault -> "Enable Recovery Key" it asks for the YubiKey OTP and then errors out.
jamie-it: ok that's consistent. Two routes: 1) we can request a temporary admin push from IT to remove the personal recovery key, let Kandji push the escrowed key, then re-enable YubiKey; or 2) if you'd prefer not to remove YubiKey now, we can re-enroll after a short reinstall into an MDM-first flow. which do you want?
Lin: I'd rather avoid reinstall if possible. downtime = bad. temp admin route sounds fine — what's the risk?
alex-sec: from security side, removing the personal recovery key temporarily is OK if done via controlled IT action and we verify escrow after. We prefer option 1 for faster onboarding. ensure YubiKey is recorded in your 2FA profile before removing anything.
tasha-people: looping in HR just so the temporary admin request is tracked in your onboarding ticket. Lin — i'll add a note to your profile. :white_check_mark:
jamie-it: Lin — can you confirm you're near your desk and have the YubiKey and a USB-C hub handy? On M2 sometimes you need a wired key for the OTP during recovery changes. also tell me whether FileVault was set up with "Personal Recovery Key" or "iCloud account" option.
Lin: at desk now, have a USB-C hub and the YubiKey. chose "Personal Recovery Key (USB)" and linked OTP.
jamie-it: perfect. I'm gonna open a temp-admin session now. deploy-bot: temp-admin session created for jamie-it (30m). ticket #ONB-4721.
jamie-it: ok Lin — I'll remove the personal recovery key, trigger Kandji to push the enterprise escrow key, then confirm with `sudo fdesetup status`. I'll DM you when done.
Lin: thanks! appreciate the quick help. :relieved:
kate-kandji: after jamie completes the change I'll watch for the device to report back. if escrow doesn't appear in 5m we'll attempt a forced MDM keyset push.
alex-sec: one more note: once the institutional key is present, please re-register your YubiKey for login 2FA (separate from FileVault) so you keep the added device security.
Lin: will do — thanks everyone.
jamie-it: done — removed personal recovery key, Kandji pushed institutional escrow, confirmed:
```bash
$ sudo fdesetup status
FileVault is On.
Users: Lin (Enabled)
Escrow: Institutional recovery key present (Kandji)
```
jamie-it: Lin, you should be unblocked. try the restart/login flow and confirm FileVault unlock still accepts your YubiKey OTP.
Lin: restarting now... unlocked with YubiKey OTP and everything looks normal. ✅
Lin: owe you coffee, jamie. :coffee:
jamie-it: happy to help! filing a short how-to for future new hires about YubiKey+FileVault+Kandji edge-case. once tasha closes onboarding ticket we'll mark this resolved.
